philosophy.title: Quiet Luxury Needs No Loudness
philosophy.p1: In a world of constant noise and mass repetition, INFLUX was born to redefine haute perfumery. We believe genuine refinement speaks with quiet confidence, where subtlety reveals the greatest power.
philosophy.p2: Every flacon is distilled from meticulously selected raw essences, providing extraordinary longevity and an intimate olfactory signature unlike any other.

about.title: About Maison INFLUX
about.subtitle: The Art of Olfactory Flow
about.p1: The name INFLUX evokes the harmonious flow of emotions, memory, and rare essences. Born from a desire to surpass commercial trends, we craft fragrances for those who value authentic purity.
about.p2: We extract only the finest raw essences sourced from Grasse and Southeast Asia, carefully macerated in small batches to preserve every subtle nuance.
about.val1Desc: Extrait de Parfum formulations that ensure all-day longevity and an intimate scent trail.
about.val2Desc: Bottles and boxes designed with architectural minimalism, letting the fragrance speak for itself.
about.val3Desc: A discovery vial included with every bottle allows you to test the scent risk-free.
